newsitem.title: UK: Color Line bid set at 31.50 Crowns/shr.
newsitem.headline: Color Line bid set at 31.50 Crowns/shr.

text.p: The bid price for Larvik Scandi Line's takeover offer for rival Norwegian ferry operator Color Line ASA has been set at 31.30 Crowns ($4.31) per share, the Oslo Stock Exchange said on Thursday.

The price was set in line with that paid by Larvik Scandi Line for an option on 50,000 shares some weeks ago, compared with a current higher trading price of 33 Crowns for Color Line shares on the Oslo bourse.
Larvik Scandi Line's option purchase took it over a 45 percent holding in Color Line which necessitated it making an offer for the rest of the shares.
Larvik Scandi Line said the offer would become unconditional if it receives acceptances giving it a minimum two thirds control of Color Line. The offer is open until July 28.
However, the company added that it reserved the right to continue the take-over attempt if it received a lower level of acceptances. ($ = 7.254 Norwegian Crowns)
